1  Writ Petition Nos.15977 , 15979,
 
 Prayer : Writ Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind  praying for the issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, directing the  respondents herein to consider the petitioners' representation date  27.12.2022 and pay the enhanced compensation on part with the  compensation decided for the adjoining lands, with all consequentia  benefits.

For Petitioners : Mr.S.Gopinathan  [in all W.Ps.]
 For Respondents : Mr.D.Ravichander  [in all W.Ps.] Special Government Pl  to R3]
 Mr.C.Vigneswaran [R4  COMMON ORDER

The relief sought for in these writ petitions is to direct the respondents to consider the representation submitted by the petitioners on 27.12.2022 seeking enhanced compensation on par with the compensation decided for the adjoining lands with all consequential benefits.

2. The grievance of the writ petitioners is that the compensation was enhanced in respect of the owners of the adjoining lands and in this regard, the petitioners submitted a representation on 27.12.2022.
The https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Writ Petition Nos.15977 , 15979, 15980 to 15983,
15985 to 15989, 15991 to 15993 of 2023 said representation is yet to be considered and thus, the writ petitioners are constrained to move the present writ petitions.

3. Learned Special Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the respondents 1 to 3 made a submission that the application seeking enhancement of compensation was made beyond the limitation period and therefore, it cannot be considered.

4. In reply, the learned counsel for the petitioners stated that the applications seeking enhancement of compensation was submitted within a period of 60 days as contemplated under the provisions of the act and therefore, the Authorities are bound to decide the applications on merits.

5. In view of the facts and circumstances, the second and third respondents are directed to verify whether the applications seeking enhancement are filed within the prescribed time as contemplated under the Act and accordingly, decide the same on merits and in accordance with law by affording an opportunity to all the parties and as expeditiously as possible.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Writ Petition Nos.15977 , 15979, 15980 to 15983, 15985 to 15989,
Accordingly, all the writ petitions are disposed of.
No costs.
